content: For Node.js xlsx/csv parsing in 2026: SheetJS (xlsx) is the de facto standard for .xlsx but the npm registry package name 'xlsx' is stuck at vulnerable 0.18.5 (SheetJS moved distribution to cdn.sheetjs.com over an npm dispute). Use the automated npm mirror @e965/xlsx (0.20.3+) instead. exceljs is effectively unmaintained (no publish since Oct 2023). papaparse remains the standard for CSV, actively maintained.
